messages:
tasha: quick flag before tomorrow's KPI huddle  launch-posts cohort shows 398 leads on our dashboard but HubSpot only surfaces 281 with launch utm_campaign. want to reconcile so the one-pager isn't misleading :eyes:
leo: which attribution window is the dash using? 14d first-touch or 7d last-touch? that alone can move numbers a lot
samir: dash is first_touch 14d by default. HS uses last_touch 7d. also our lead-routing rules reassign to nurture when Marketo touches within 48h, which could change campaign tags
maria ng: good catch. we should present a short "what changed" note in the dashboard explaining the three metrics we'll show (raw dash, deduped emails, HS-tagged). that will help leadership understand variance
ben (sales): sales pipeline count for that week is ~268; also note a handful of high-ARR leads got routed to enterprise and aren't in the standard funnel view
tasha: propose immediate actions: 1) samir run distinct-email dedupe across the launch window 2) leo add a small footnote on the dash about attribution window + toggle 3) ben confirm whether enterprise-routing affected >5 leads 4) samir export the top 20 lead emails for quick owner check
samir: running quick SQL now:
```sql
select count(distinct email) as unique_leads
from events.leads
where received_at between '2026-03-08' and '2026-03-15'
and utm_campaign = 'launch-q2';
```
results in ~349 distinct emails. suggests overlap from multi-touch accounts for ~49 leads vs the raw dash
leo: i'll add a tiny badge: "First-touch (14d) - toggle to Last-touch (7d)" and a 1-line note in the dashboard readme explaining Marketo routing behavior
maria ng: great. for the KPI review we'll show: dashboard raw=398, deduped distinct emails=349, HubSpot tagged=281, SFDC pipeline=268. add conv->MQL trend sparkline as requested by leadership
ben (sales): pls include conversion rate to MQL and MQL->SQL velocity; that'll be the follow-up question from CRO
tasha: noted. meet TOM 9:00 to finalize the one-pager. thanks all :rocket:
